description: Azure Functions .NET 8 isolated app (Cloud Migration Fortune API) + Azure Bicep infra + azure-app/README.md. Creates all source files under /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/ and Bicep templates under /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/infra/bicep/. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/MigrationFortune.csproj. SDK=Microsoft.NET.Sdk, OutputType=Exe, TargetFramework=net8.0, AzureFunctionsVersion=v4, Nullable=enable, ImplicitUsings=enable. NuGet packages: Microsoft.Azure.Functions.Worker Version='1.*', Microsoft.Azure.Functions.Worker.Extensions.Http Version='3.*', Microsoft.Azure.Functions.Worker.Extensions.Storage.Blobs Version='6.*', Azure.Storage.Blobs Version='12.*'. No OutputType override needed — Exe is correct for isolated worker.

2. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Models/AssessRequest.cs. Namespace MigrationFortune.Models. Properties with [JsonPropertyName] camelCase: WorkloadName (string?), Description (string?), TechStack (string[]?), YearsInProduction (int?). Use System.Text.Json.Serialization.

3. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Models/AssessmentResult.cs. Namespace MigrationFortune.Models. Properties with [JsonPropertyName] camelCase: AssessmentId (string), WorkloadName (string), MigrationComplexity (string), RecommendedStrategy (string), SuccessProbability (int), Fortune (string), DivineAdvice (string), AssessedAt (string), Source (string), StoragePath (string).

4. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Services/FortuneEngine.cs. Namespace MigrationFortune.Services. Public class FortuneEngine. Single public method: AssessmentResult Assess(AssessRequest req, string source, Random rng). Implementation details: (a) Complexity: legendaryDouble = req.YearsInProduction >= 10 AND req.TechStack != null AND req.TechStack.Any(t => t.Equals('COBOL', StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)). int total = legendaryDouble ? 115 : 100; int r = rng.Next(0, total); complexity = r<20?'Easy':r<55?'Medium':r<85?'Hard':'Legendary'. (b) 6Rs: int r2=rng.Next(0,100); strategy = r2<25?'Rehost':r2<50?'Replatform':r2<70?'Refactor':r2<85?'Repurchase':r2<95?'Retire':'Retain'. (c) successProbability: if Legendary → rng.Next(1,43). Else: int[] pool = new int[59]; for(int i=0;i<58;i++) pool[i]=42+i; pool[58]=42; int sp=pool[rng.Next(0,59)]. (d) Fortune: int rf=rng.Next(0,100); fortune = rf<10?'大吉':rf<35?'吉':rf<60?'中吉':rf<80?'小吉':rf<90?'末吉':rf<98?'凶':'大凶'. (e) DivineAdvice: string[] advices = exactly the 16 strings listed in plan.md (in order); pick rng.Next(0,16). (f) Build result: assessmentId=Guid.NewGuid().ToString(), assessedAt=DateTime.UtcNow.ToString('o'), storagePath=$'assessments/{assessmentId}.json'.

5. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Services/BlobStorageService.cs. Namespace MigrationFortune.Services. Constructor: reads Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable('AzureWebJobsStorage'), creates BlobServiceClient. Private const containerName='assessments'. Method SaveAsync(string id, AssessmentResult result): get container client, CreateIfNotExistsAsync(PublicAccessType.None), upload blob '{id}.json' with BinaryData.FromString(JsonSerializer.Serialize(result)). Method GetAsync(string id) → AssessmentResult?: download blob '{id}.json'; catch RequestFailedException where ErrorCode=='BlobNotFound' → return null; deserialize and return.

6. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Functions/AssessFunction.cs. Namespace MigrationFortune.Functions. Constructor injects FortuneEngine _fortune and BlobStorageService _blob. [Function('Assess')] async Task<HttpResponseData> RunAsync([HttpTrigger(AuthorizationLevel.Anonymous,'post',Route='assess')] HttpRequestData req). X-Force-Seed: req.Headers.TryGetValues('X-Force-Seed', out IEnumerable<string>? seeds); bool hasSeed = seeds != null && seeds.Any() && int.TryParse(seeds.First(), out int seedVal); Random rng = hasSeed ? new Random(seedVal) : Random.Shared. Body: string body = await req.ReadAsStringAsync(); AssessRequest? input = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AssessRequest>(body, new JsonSerializerOptions{PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true}). Validation 400: input==null → 400 'invalid request body'; input.WorkloadName==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input.WorkloadName) → 400 'workloadName is required'; input.Description==null||string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input.Description) → 400 'description is required'; input.YearsInProduction.HasValue && input.YearsInProduction.Value<0 → 400 'yearsInProduction must be >= 0'. 400 response: HttpResponseData r=req.CreateResponse(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest); r.WriteAsJsonAsync(new{error=msg}); return r. On success: call _fortune.Assess, call await _blob.SaveAsync, return 200 JSON result.

7. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Functions/GetAssessmentFunction.cs. Namespace MigrationFortune.Functions. Constructor injects BlobStorageService _blob. [Function('GetAssessment')] async Task<HttpResponseData> RunAsync([HttpTrigger(AuthorizationLevel.Anonymous,'get',Route='assessment/{id}')] HttpRequestData req, string id). var result = await _blob.GetAsync(id); if null → 404 with {error:'Assessment not found',id:id}; else → 200 JSON result.

8. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/Program.cs. using Microsoft.Azure.Functions.Worker; using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection; using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting; using MigrationFortune.Services; var host = new HostBuilder().ConfigureFunctionsWorkerDefaults().ConfigureServices(services => { services.AddSingleton<BlobStorageService>(); services.AddSingleton<FortuneEngine>(); }).Build(); await host.RunAsync();

10. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/local.settings.json: {"IsEncrypted":false,"Values":{"AzureWebJobsStorage":"UseDevelopmentStorage=true","FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME":"dotnet-isolated"}} — this file is gitignored and contains only dev defaults, no real credentials.

11. Run build verification: DOTNET_ROOT=/opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@8/libexec /opt/homebrew/opt/dotnet@8/libexec/dotnet build /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/src/MigrationFortune.csproj — must print 'Build succeeded.' Fix any compile errors before proceeding.

12. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/infra/bicep/storage.bicep. Params: location (string), prefix (string), tags (object). Resources: storageAccount (Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts@2023-01-01) kind=StorageV2, sku.name=Standard_LRS, accessTier=Hot, allowBlobPublicAccess=false. blobService (Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices@2023-01-01). blobContainer 'assessments' (Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers@2023-01-01) publicAccess=None. All three resources tagged with tags param. Output: storageAccountName (string), storageAccountId (string).

13. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/infra/bicep/functions.bicep. Params: location (string), prefix (string), storageAccountName (string), tags (object). Resources: appServicePlan (Microsoft.Web/serverfarms@2022-09-01) kind='linux', sku.name='Y1'/tier='Dynamic'. functionApp (Microsoft.Web/sites@2022-09-01) kind='functionapp,linux', identity.type='SystemAssigned', siteConfig.linuxFxVersion='DOTNET-ISOLATED|8.0', appSettings=[{name:'FUNCTIONS_WORKER_RUNTIME',value:'dotnet-isolated'},{name:'AzureWebJobsStorage__accountName',value:storageAccountName},{name:'WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE',value:'1'}]. Role assignment: roleAssignment (Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments@2022-04-01) scope=storageAccount, roleDefinitionId='/subscriptions/${subscription().subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/ba92f5b4-2d11-453d-a403-e96b0029c9fe' (Storage Blob Data Contributor), principalId=functionApp.identity.principalId, principalType='ServicePrincipal'. Use storage accountName to reference resource. All resources tagged.

14. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/infra/bicep/main.bicep. Params: location string = 'japaneast', prefix string = 'atoaPoc'. var tags object = {project:'atoa-poc',env:'dev',app:'migration-fortune',managedBy:'bicep'}. Module storageModule: './storage.bicep' with params. Module functionsModule: './functions.bicep' with params including storageAccountName from storageModule output.

15. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/infra/bicep/parameters/poc.bicepparam (create /parameters subdirectory first). Content: using '../main.bicep' param location = 'japaneast' param prefix = 'atoaPoc'

16. Create /Users/koji/kiro2/atoa/azure-app/README.md. Sections: Prerequisites (Azure CLI 2.x+, Azure Functions Core Tools v4, .NET 8, Azurite for local storage), Local development (azurite --silent &, func start), Deploy to Azure (az login, az group create, az deployment group create --template-file infra/bicep/main.bicep --parameters infra/bicep/parameters/poc.bicepparam), Cost notes (Consumption plan free tier, Blob Storage ~$0.02/GB), Cleanup (refer to ../../cleanup-azure.sh).
acceptance_criteria: All 16 divine advice strings are present verbatim in FortuneEngine.cs
Legendary complexity doubles when yearsInProduction>=10 AND techStack contains COBOL
successProbability mode is 42 (appears in pool twice); range [1,42] when Legendary
X-Force-Seed header causes seeded Random (new Random(seed)) instead of Random.Shared
BlobStorageService reads AzureWebJobsStorage env var only — no hardcoded connection strings
local.settings.json contains only UseDevelopmentStorage=true, no real credentials
All 4 Bicep files exist and are syntactically valid
All Bicep resources tagged with project=atoa-poc, env=dev, app=migration-fortune, managedBy=bicep
findings: All 16 steps implemented and build verified. Key fix: seedVal must be declared before the short-circuit &&-chain (CS0165 definite-assignment). blobService and blobContainer child resources do not support tags in their ARM schema so tags are applied only to storageAccount, appServicePlan, and functionApp. roleAssignment uses subscriptionResourceId() helper for the role definition ID. Build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors.
